name: Prince Ba'alorien

facts.text: Level 78, 100,000 health. Every 5 seconds the nearest controlled pet within 2,000 dies and he heals by its maximum health (changed from every pet every turn, owner 2026-10-14).
Albion's and Hibernia's Darkness Falls raids were each defeated at him on 2026-11-04 (two wipes each).

story: Prince Ba'alorien is Asmoien's rival in everything, and in appetite above all. He too eats the servants of mortal masters, and he keeps their bones piled by his throne, beasts and elementals and the cold husks of bound spirits, so that visitors can see the tally. The imps say the two princes keep count against each other. Ba'alorien is ahead. He intends to stay ahead, and every pet-master who walks into his hall with a servant at heel is another point to him.
legend: Same as Asmoien: a pet dies every five seconds within two thousand of him and he heals by its health. Pets out of the hall, far away, before anyone pulls. He has wiped more Darkness Falls raids than any other prince for exactly that reason.

lairEntry: Bones of beasts, not men, are piled by the throne.

phases.text: Ba'alorien devours a pet and is mended!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Prince Ba'alorien has fallen. His tally ends.

briefing: PETS OUT for baalorien too. same rule, 2000+ away
